description.en: Plugins and skills for DeepSeek Harness, maintained alongside the dsh-Veyra fork.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件与技能，随 dsh-Veyra fork 维护。

description.en: Counts every tool call and records why each failure happened, then hands you the ones you pick as text to paste into a conversation — statistics and the recent failure samples, with a prompt that asks the model to find the repeat offender and fix it.
description.zh: 统计每次工具调用、记下每次失败的原因。勾选出问题的工具，一键把统计与近期失败样本连同分析提示词复制走，粘进对话就能让模型找出反复出错的那一个并给出修复。

description.en: Create and manage agents in a panel instead of a config file: each one gets its own prompt, capability set, tool restrictions and preferred skills, and the main agent can create them for you.
description.zh: 用面板而不是配置文件来创建和管理智能体：每个智能体有自己的提示词、能力集、工具限制与优选技能，主智能体也能替你创建它们。

description.en: Tiered, agent-decided context compaction: a pressure ladder, a deterministic pre-prune gated on how much it actually reclaims, and compaction the model can call itself. Keeps long sessions alive without churning the prompt cache.
description.zh: 分层、由智能体决定的高质量上下文压缩：压力阶梯、以"真的回收了多少"为门槛的确定性预剪枝，以及模型可自行调用的压缩工具。让长会话活得下去，又不会反复冲掉提示缓存。

description.en: Browse, search and install skills and MCP servers from one panel, instead of hand-editing profile config rows to add each one.
description.zh: 在一个面板里浏览、搜索、安装技能与 MCP 服务器，不必为每一件都手改 profile 配置行。

description.en: An SSH terminal inside DSH: connection profiles, jump hosts, SFTP, port forwarding and host-key pinning. Passwords go to the credentials service, never into the profile file.
description.zh: 把 SSH 终端搬进 DSH：连接档案、跳板、SFTP、端口转发与主机密钥固定。密码只进凭据服务，档案文件里没有任何秘密。

description.en: Select text in any application and get a native toolbar: translate, copy, explain, summarize. Answers render as Markdown, scroll, expand, and copy on drag-select. It takes over the right mouse button, so the application menu you would otherwise get does not appear in front of it.
description.zh: 在任何应用里划词，弹出原生工具条：翻译、复制、解释、总结。结果按 Markdown 渲染，可滚动、可展开、可拖选复制。它接管右键，所以应用自带的右键菜单不会再冒出来跟你抢。仅 Windows。

description.en: Replaces the client appearance with a whole theme: colours, shape, sidebar treatment and a wallpaper that can be an image, a looping video or code. Ships several finished themes, and a CLI plus skill so an agent can build, check and switch them. The wallpaper can cover the left menu or stay in the conversation area.
description.zh: 把客户端外观整体换掉：配色、圆角、左侧菜单样式，以及一张可以是图片、无缝循环视频或代码的壁纸。自带几套成品主题，并提供 CLI 与技能，让 Agent 能自己建主题、检配色、切换。壁纸可以选择覆盖左侧菜单，或只留在对话区。

description.en: Read the user’s own PC WeChat — sessions, history, images, unread, search and export — and reply per a per-person policy: direct, draft, notify or blacklist. New messages are merged per conversation before they reach the agent. Windows only.
description.zh: 读取用户本人的 PC 微信：会话、聊天记录、图片、未读、检索与导出；按每人策略回复（直接代回 / 起草确认 / 只提醒 / 黑名单），同一好友/群的新消息合并后再交给 Agent。仅 Windows。

description.en: An automatic customer-service desk for virtual goods on Xianyu (Goofish): watch buyer messages in real time, ship the card stock the moment an order is placed, and answer questions through the DSH agent with per-item skills. Ships with a panel for cards, orders, delivery logs and skill binding.
description.zh: 闲鱼虚拟商品自动客服：实时监听买家消息，拍下即发卡密，并用 DSH 的 agent 与技能回答买家问题。附带卡券、订单、发货记录与技能绑定面板。

description.en: Drive Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agent CLIs from DSH: install and upgrade them, and manage their MCP servers, skills and prompts in one place.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里驱动 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 Agent CLI：安装升级，并统一管理它们的 MCP、技能与提示词。

description.en: A card-style market tab beside Installed: switch between index sources, search, and install, update, uninstall, enable or disable many plugins in one batch. It reads and changes plugins through the client's own Remote interfaces, so the source list is the same one Settings edits.
description.zh: 在「已安装」旁边多一个卡片式市场标签页：切换市场源、搜索，并批量安装、更新、卸载、启用或停用。读取与改动都走客户端自己的 Remote 接口，所以源列表就是「设置 → 插件 → 索引源」那一份。

description.en: Keep skills, sessions, settings and plugin lists aligned across machines through a private Git repository, WebDAV or a local folder.
description.zh: 通过私有 Git 仓库、WebDAV 或本地文件夹，让多台机器上的技能、会话、设置和插件清单保持一致。

description.en: Probe, trim, transcode, burn subtitles, storyboard and export GIFs with the local FFmpeg/FFprobe.
description.zh: 用本机 FFmpeg/FFprobe 探测、剪辑、转码、烧录字幕、生成分镜总览图与 GIF。

description.en: A local and online music player for DSH: NetEase, QQ, KuGou, Navidrome, lyrics, EQ and crossfade.
description.zh: DSH 本地与在线音乐播放器：网易云、QQ、酷狗、Navidrome、歌词、均衡器与智能过渡。

description.en: Free models with no sign-up and no API key: pick one and chat. Real availability checks, a sign-in dialog with the link when a browser blocks the popup, multiple accounts with balances on one page (CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy included), any OpenAI-compatible endpoint you already have a key for, and automatic retry on another model when the router fails. One click installs the Vyra plugin market and adds its index source, and the plugin ships a DSH onboarding skill that helps the agent recommend and install a plugin set for your needs.
description.zh: 装上就能用的免费模型：不用注册、不用填 key，选一个就能聊。真实可用性检测、登录弹窗（浏览器被拦截时可复制链接）、多账号与积分管理（含 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy）、任何已有 Key 的 OpenAI 兼容接口，以及自动选择失败时换模型重试。设置页可一键安装 Vyra 插件市场并添加索引源；插件还会初始化一个 DSH 使用指南技能，帮 Agent 按你的需求推荐并安装插件组合。

description.en: Screen recording and annotated screenshots in the DSH composer: choose the desktop, a display, a window or a region; record system audio and microphone; save MP4 (H.264/AAC) or WebM; configure separate video and screenshot folders, format and shortcuts in the settings page; screenshots stay fast with no loading overlay and can hide DSH to capture other apps. Toolbar buttons show their shortcut on hover, and the screenshot overlay reads text out of the selection (Windows built-in OCR, or any dsh-tool-ocr engine) and copies the text, the image or the file in one click. Also installs a vsr CLI and an agent skill. No Python or ffmpeg required.
description.zh: DSH 输入框工具条里的录屏与截图：选择整个桌面 / 显示器 / 窗口 / 自定义区域，录系统声音和麦克风，默认保存 MP4（H.264/AAC）或 WebM；设置页可分别配置视频与截图的存储目录、格式和快捷键；截图走常驻服务、不显示加载提示，单张几十毫秒，也可以隐藏 DSH 截取其他应用。鼠标悬停在按钮上会显示快捷键；截图拖框即识别文字（Windows 自带 OCR，或读取 dsh-tool-ocr 配置的引擎），一键复制文字 / 图片 / 文件，和 QQ、微信截图一样顺手。同时安装 vsr CLI 和 Agent 技能。不需要 Python 或 ffmpeg。

description.en: Connect WeChat, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord and Matrix to DSH, with Agent tools for proactive messages and files.
description.zh: 把微信、飞书、企微、钉钉、QQ、Telegram、WhatsApp、Slack、Discord、Matrix 接入 DSH；Agent 可直接主动发送文字和文件。

description.en: Extract text from images and PDFs: read a born-digital text layer, or OCR a scan with any configured engine — including the OCR engine built into Windows 10/11, which needs nothing installed.
description.zh: 从图片和 PDF 里取文字：数字版 PDF 直接读文字层，扫描件走 OCR。可以接任意配置的引擎，也可以用 Windows 10/11 自带的 OCR——什么都不用装。

description.en: The obra Superpowers skill collection plus session bootstrap for a DSH profile.
description.zh: obra Superpowers 技能集，附带会话引导。

description.en: Framework upgrade safety and plugin version gating for DSH: one-click upgrade with automatic rollback on failure, rollback to the previous release, automatic disabling of plugins that no longer fit, plus a multi-source plugin market whose sources can point at internal mirrors, private indexes or a local Git repository for intranet-only offline installs.
description.zh: 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：一键升级、失败自动回滚、升级后回滚上版、旧插件不适配自动禁用；内置多源插件市场为发现层，插件源全部可自定义，可指向公司内网私有源、私有索引、本地 Git 仓库，纯内网离线可用。

description.en: A community plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness, built to the official plugin spec: browse, search and install 6000+ hand-verified npm plugins out of 23000+ indexed, without leaving the app.
description.zh: 遵循官方规范的社区插件市场：收录 23000+ 社区插件、其中 6000+ 已发布 npm 包可一键安装，每日更新。

description.en: Lightweight agent workflow for DeepSeek Harness: one workflow = one JSON (React Flow native) with prompts inline, compiled into a dispatch plan the model executes itself. No execution engine; optional per-workflow run state kept by the model in a YAML file.
description.zh: 轻量智能体工作流：一个工作流就是一份 JSON（React Flow 原生），提示词内联，编译成模型自己执行的分派计划；没有执行引擎，可选的运行状态由模型写在 YAML 里。

description.en: StudyMate learning skills and lesson engine, maintained here with audio lessons, narrated video and hands-on workshops: turn a subject into lessons, practice and projects inside DSH. Based on StudyMate by Cattofu (MIT).
description.zh: StudyMate 学习技能与课程引擎：把一门科目拆成课程、练习与项目，并可将每一课派生为音频课、旁白视频和动手工作坊。基于 Cattofu 的 StudyMate（MIT）。

description.en: Expert Orchestrator: a multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DSH — triage, PM planning, delegation to domain experts through a merged roster (summon_expert), a dependency-DAG taskboard, a file message bus, tiered delivery gates and experience pooling.
description.zh: 专家编排模式：多智能体任务编排，分诊、PM 先行规划、专家委派、依赖 DAG 任务板、消息总线并行落盘、分级交付门禁、经验池沉淀。

description.en: Multi-agent team collaboration for DSH: captain, members, tasks with dependencies and messaging, driven by natural language, with a tree monitor in the web GUI. Members can be composed from an Agent preset.
description.zh: 多智能体团队协作：队长、成员、带依赖的任务与消息，自然语言驱动，带树形监控面板。成员可由 Agent 预设组装。

description.en: A file manager in the right Sidebar: browse every workspace file type (images, video, audio, documents, archives, code), zoom the whole grid, switch compact/detailed list views, preview PDFs and text in the panel, and rename, copy, delete, reveal or insert files into the composer.
description.zh: 右侧栏文件管理：浏览工作区的全部文件类型（图片、视频、音频、文档、压缩包、代码等），网格可整体缩放，列表支持简洁/详细信息，面板内预览 PDF 与文本，并支持重命名、复制、删除、打开所在位置及引用到输入框。

description.en: A console for the harness itself: read and switch models, read and write settings, enable or disable plugins and MCP servers, and change the theme and layout — from an agent tool or from a sidebar panel, both dispatching through one action registry. Its point is its boundary as much as its reach: sandbox mode, permission presets, approval answers and credential writes are refused for every caller, with the reason and who should do it instead shown rather than hidden.
description.zh: 面向 harness 自身的控制台：查看与切换模型、读写设置、启停插件与 MCP、调整主题与布局，Agent 工具与侧栏面板共用同一张动作注册表。这个插件同样在意「不能做什么」：沙箱模式、权限预设、审批应答与凭据写入对任何调用方都永久拒绝，并把拒绝原因与该由谁来做摊开显示。

description.en: Splits the OpenDesign skill library into nine business domains, each paired with its own agent, so a user loads only the work they actually do. A settings panel switches domains on and off and applies the change immediately; the bundled odx CLI does the same from a terminal. Ships 85 craft skills plus 152 design-system contracts, and one director agent coordinates whatever is enabled.
description.zh: 把 OpenDesign 技能库按业务领域切成九个包，每包配一个同名 Agent，只加载真正用得上的那部分。在设置页里开关领域即写即生效，也可用自带的 odx 命令操作。含 85 个工艺技能与 152 套设计系统契约，再由一个编排 Agent 统一调度已启用的领域。
